name: Gatam Papam Gatam Dukham
text:
गतं पापं गतं दुःखं गतं दारिद्र्यमेव च ।
आगता सुखसम्पत्तिः पुण्योऽहं तव दर्शनात् ॥
meaning: Gone is wrongdoing, gone is sorrow, gone is poverty too; joy and prosperity have come. I am blessed by the sight of you.
purpose: A verse of darshan, seeing the divine.
note: A verse said at darshan, on seeing the deity. Sarvakali’s list, with the spelling “Gatam” and the standard ending, at her direction.
source: A darshan verse in common devotional use; wording as confirmed by Sarvakali
